newsitem.title: UAE: Cricket-New Zealand win toss and opt to bat.
newsitem.headline: Cricket-New Zealand win toss and opt to bat.

text.p: New Zealand won the toss and decided to bat against Sri Lanka in the Singer Champions' Trophy tournament on Monday.
New Zealand - Lee Germon (captain), Nathan Astle, Craig Spearman, Adam Parore, Stephen Fleming, Chris Cairns, Mark Greatbatch, Chris Harris, Dipak Patel, Simon Doull, Danny Morrison.

Sri Lanka - Arjuna Ranatunga (captain), Sanath Jayasuriya, Romesh Kaluwitharana, Marvan Atapattu, Aravinda de Silva, Hashan Tillekeratne, Roshan Mahanama, Upul Chandana, Chaminda Vaas, Muttiah Muralitharan, Sanjeeva de Silva.
